summary: Named lighting moods (day, sunset, twilight, night, spooky, underwater) with real volumetric fog (Atmosphere instance), colour grading, and blending for day/night cycles.
usage: Atmosphere.blend("day", "night", t) -> preset  -- for day/night cycles
Atmosphere.Presets.<name>  -- data you can copy and tweak; Atmosphere.validate(preset)

summary: Player-list stats (leaderstats) set only by the server, plus ranking helpers and number abbreviation for in-world boards and HUD panels.
usage: Leaderboard.define(player, {"Cash", "Mushrooms"})  -- on PlayerAdded, up to 4 stats

summary: Action feedback: floating +N pop-ups, HUD bounce and flash, particle bursts, a colour palette, and number formatting.
usage: Feedback.delta(1250) -> "+1,250"; Feedback.spread(i, n) for stacked pop-ups; palette: reward, gain, loss, info, magic

summary: Qualitative progression: level-gated unlock rules, newly-unlocked detection for announcements, next-unlock hints, and showing/hiding world content tagged with an Unlock attribute.
usage: local RULES = Unlocks.define({ {id="glow_basket", level=5, title="Glowing basket"}, ... })
Unlocks.newly(RULES, oldLevel, newLevel) -> rules crossed (announce them)
Unlocks.isUnlocked(RULES, id, level); Unlocks.unlockedAt(RULES, level); Unlocks.nextAfter(RULES, level)
Unlocks.applyWorld(workspace, RULES, level)  -- parts/models with attribute Unlock="<id>"
